messages:
Sam: heads-up — we started getting a flurry of customer 401s ~07:32 UTC. Support queue is filling. Affected customers report errors immediately after key rotation window. Filing here to coordinate.

Jess: seeing the same in dashboards :eyes:. auth-service 5xxs are flat but token-introspect is returning 401s for many requests. spike graph attached (links omitted).

ops-bot: ALERT: auth.token_validation.error_rate > 3% for 12m on prod (service: auth-service, env: prod).

Mike: oncall — i'm on it. first step: confirm rotation job succeeded and new key version published to JWKS endpoint. poking the JWKS now.

Anna: quick repro: curl against API with a recently minted API key shows 401 and error json {"error":"invalid_signature","detail":"kid mismatch"}. Copying curl:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' https://api.redwood.example/v1/models
```
response:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_signature","kid_provided":"k3","jwks_current":"k2"}
```

Sam: interesting — looks like some tokens are being signed with kid=k3 but auth-service is validating against k2 cache. Could be key propagation lag or cache invalidation bug.

Jess: can we check redis cache for jwks_version and the rotate job logs? last rotate job finished at 07:30 UTC per jobs svc.

Mike: found this in rotate job output:
```
INFO publish_jwks: new_kid=k3
INFO invalidate_cache: attempted=all services
WARN cache_invalidate_ack_timeout: service=auth-service
```

Anna: auth-service logs show this sequence:
```
07:31:02 auth svc starting jwks refresh
07:31:03 fetched jwks v3
07:31:03 failed to apply jwks: EACCES writing /var/cache/jwks.json
07:31:03 falling back to in-memory cached jwks v2
```

Sam: EACCES on disk write — that's new. Did something change to the auth-service pod's filesystem permissions during deploy?

Mike: I see recent image change rolled out ~07:28 — configmap mount path changed ownership in container image (accidental). quick fix options: 1) restart pods after fixing init script to chown, 2) enable temporary fallback mode allowing multiple key validation (accept legacy kid) in auth config, 3) rollback rotation to previous key so tokens match cached jwks v2.

Jess: what's fastest with lowest blast radius? We need customer traffic to be accepted ASAP.

Anna: option 2 is fastest — toggle permissive multi-kid accept in runtime config via feature-flag service. It's a guarded change: validators will accept either k2 or k3 while we fix filesystem. Command:
```
POST https://internal-ff.redwood/flags/auth.allow_multi_kid {"value":true}
```
Should take effect within ~30s.

Mike: I can flip it, but we should still plan a full rollback of rotation if flip fails. I'll prepare the rollback command:
```
redwood-ops rotate-key --env prod --to-version v2 --force
```

Sam: flip the flag now and monitor 401s + support queue. @Jess please confirm with customers if errors drop.

Mike: flipping the flag in 3..2..1.

ops-bot: ACTION: feature flag auth.allow_multi_kid set to true by Mike at 07:36:12 UTC.

Anna: logs — validators now accept both kids. quick check: curl now returns 200 for previously failing token.

Sam: support update: customers on the queue confirming restored access :thumbsup:. 401 rate dropped from 4.2% -> 0.6% over 10m.

Jess: great. next steps: fix the underlying file permission bug in the image and redeploy, and then clear the feature flag and re-run rotation with proper cache invalidation.

Mike: filing infra PR to re-add chown in init script and add unit test that container can write /var/cache. Also adding a post-rotation ack step to the rotate job to fail loudly if any service doesn't acknowledge cache invalidate within 30s.

Anna: will follow up with auth-service patch to fallback to in-memory write-only mode more gracefully and log clearer errors. Also adding an integration test that simulates permission errors during JWKS refresh.

Sam: open action items: [P1] revert flag (safe) once rotation completes, [P2] infra image fix + redeploy, [P3] rotate job: add ack gating, [P4] post-incident customer comms draft.

Jess: tagging postmortem — we'll run RCA tomorrow and include timeline + CC customers. Thanks everyone. :heart:

Mike: rolling the infra image change to staging now. will notify when prod rollout scheduled.

ops-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED TEMPORARY — auth.allow_multi_kid flag will be reverted after confirmed rotation.

Sam: closing thread for now. I'll open a follow-up thread for the postmortem doc and customer notes.
